# Tabler UI

`tabler-1.7.3.min.css` is the official compiled stylesheet from `@tabler/core@1.7.3`.

- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@tabler/core/-/core-1.7.3.tgz
- Original CSS SHA-256: `00601301716c0bd97acbec6c2b6cb98f257d148063ef168aa06f902b1e7d9ea5`
- Source: https://github.com/tabler/tabler
- License: https://github.com/tabler/tabler/blob/dev/LICENSE; Git blob `aa69649cde83c2d6517ec2498a9c10f5bb3bf54c`; see `TABLER-LICENSE`. The permission notice is also embedded in the playground HTML.

Only the file-level `@charset` declaration and source-map comment are removed for inline use. The upstream copyright banner is retained. The CSS has no external imports or asset URLs. No Tabler JavaScript or demo plugins are bundled.

The stylesheet is embedded before the workspace layout styles in `src/playground.rs`. Update the pinned version, checksum and license together when upgrading.
